title: Rewriting and presentations of quasicategories
summary: We show that the methods of rewriting theory to establish coherence theorems can applied at the level of quasicategories. More precisely, for any category C which admits a presentation by a convergent rewrite system, we show that the corresponding weak (infinity,1)-category admits an Amick-Groves-Squier style presentation whose generators correspond to (some of) the critical branchings of the rewrite system.
